## Overview

Analyses PsPM spontaneous fluctuation (SF) output by condition epoch. For each SF method (AUC, SCL, MP, DCM), a linear mixed model is fit:

`value ~ condition + (1 | pid)`

**Conditions:** baseline, pos_induction, neg_induction, pos_recovery, neg_recovery

**Planned contrasts:**

-   pos_induction vs neg_induction (main emotion comparison)
-   each induction vs baseline (induction effect)
-   each induction vs its recovery (recovery effect)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(here)

## Load data

```{r load-labels}
label_files <- list.files(labels_dir,
                          pattern = "_epochs_conditions_psychopy_labels\\.csv$",
                          full.names = TRUE)

if (length(label_files) == 0) {
  stop("No epoch label CSVs found in: ", labels_dir,
       "\nRe-run 02_create_pspm_onsets_psychopy.py to generate them.")
}

labels <- map_dfr(label_files, function(f) {
  pid <- str_extract(basename(f), "^\\d+")
  read.csv(f) |> mutate(pid = pid)
})
```

```{r load-stats}
load_stats <- function(method) {
  files <- list.files(stats_dir,
                      pattern = paste0("_", method, "_model_statistics\\.tsv$"),
                      full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    message("No stats files found for method: ", method)
    return(NULL)
  }
  map_dfr(files, function(f) {
    pid    <- str_extract(basename(f), "^\\d+")
    lines  <- readLines(f)
    cols   <- str_split(lines[2], "\t")[[1]]
    vals   <- str_split(lines[3], "\t")[[1]]
    keep   <- cols != ""
    cols   <- cols[keep]
    vals   <- as.numeric(vals[keep])
    epoch_nums <- as.integer(str_extract(cols, "(?<=Epoch #)\\d+"))
    tibble(pid = pid, method = method, epoch_num = epoch_nums, value = vals)
  })
}

stats <- map_dfr(methods, load_stats)
```

```{r join}
df <- stats |>
  left_join(labels |> select(pid, epoch_num, condition),
            by = c("pid", "epoch_num")) |>
  mutate(
    pid       = factor(pid),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("baseline",
                                             "pos_induction",
                                             "pos_recovery", "neg_induction",  "neg_recovery"))
  )

missing_labels <- df |> filter(is.na(condition))
if (nrow(missing_labels) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(missing_labels), " rows could not be matched to a condition label.")
}
```

### Data summary

```{r data-summary}
df |>
  group_by(method, condition) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(c(mean, sd), \(x) round(x, 6))) |>
  kable(caption = "Mean SF value per method and condition") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

### Raw values by condition

```{r plot-raw, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
df |>
  filter(!all(value == 0), .by = method) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = value, colour = pid, group = pid)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "SF value", colour = "Participant",
       title = "SF values per participant by condition and method")
```

## Planned contrasts

```{r contrasts-def}
contrasts_of_interest <- list(
  "pos_induction vs neg_induction" = c(pos_induction = 1,  neg_induction = -1),
  "pos_induction vs baseline"      = c(pos_induction = 1,  baseline = -1),
  "neg_induction vs baseline"      = c(neg_induction = 1,  baseline = -1),
  "pos_induction vs pos_recovery"  = c(pos_induction = 1,  pos_recovery = -1),
  "neg_induction vs neg_recovery"  = c(neg_induction = 1,  neg_recovery = -1)
)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Models

```{r models, results='asis'}
for (m in methods) {
  cat("\n\n###", toupper(m), "\n\n")

  df_m <- df |> filter(method == m)

  if (nrow(df_m) == 0 || all(df_m$value == 0)) {
    cat("*Skipped — all values are zero (model may not have converged).*\n\n")
    next
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(value ~ condition + (1 | pid), data = df_m, REML = TRUE),
    error = function(e) { cat("*Model error:*", e$message, "\n\n"); NULL }
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) next

  # Fixed effects table
  fe <- as.data.frame(summary(fit)$coefficients) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 5)))

  cat("**Fixed effects:**\n\n")
  print(kable(fe, caption = paste("Fixed effects —", toupper(m))) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")))

  # Estimated marginal means
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ condition)
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 6)))

  cat("\n\n**Estimated marginal means:**\n\n")
  print(kable(emm_df, caption = paste("EMMs —", toupper(m))) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")))

  # Planned contrasts
  con <- summary(contrast(emm, method = contrasts_of_interest, adjust = "none"),
                 infer = TRUE) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 5)))

  cat("\n\n**Planned contrasts:**\n\n")
  print(kable(con, caption = paste("Contrasts —", toupper(m))) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")))
}
```
